title: 9. Relationship Between CAG and Public Accounts Committee (PAC)

blocks.content: The CAG acts as a guide and friend of the Public Accounts Committee. While the CAG audits the accounts, the PAC examines the reports and ensures corrective action.
The CAG acts as a guide and friend of the Public Accounts Committee.

rows: Acts as a guide and friend to the committee
Receives guidance and reports from the CAG
Examines reports and ensures corrective action

items: CAG is frequently tested as the 'friend, philosopher, and guide' of the Public Accounts Committee (PAC).
Note the division of work: CAG audits the accounts, whereas PAC examines the audit reports and enforces corrective action.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CAG functions as a guide and friend to the Public Accounts Committee (PAC).
The CAG is responsible for auditing the accounts.
The PAC reviews the reports generated by the CAG and ensures corrective actions are taken.
